investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Harborpine Shop (online retail); Platform: AWS ap-south-1 (zones ap-south-1a/ap-south-1b/ap-south-1c); network range 10.181.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster harbor-prod-apsout (EKS); cart-service pods run with 4 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
